notes.title: V1.1.1.0 - BBQ SIMULATOR - Broad Improvement & Fix Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Its been a while the BBQ Simulator: The Squad get improvement & fix update. We listen our player feedbacks carefully and we got completely solid version right now for all of our 14 modes. 

Also we got some awesome news! We want huge thanks to 125.000 + BBQ Lovers and our great community on Steam!

We listened to the feedback of our valuable players and made some improvements and many fix & boost and improvements for the BBQ Simulator: The Squad.

So what's waiting for you in this update:

- All game mode (14) mechanics improved for better game experience.
- All game achievements re-designed and fixed (26 / 26).
- Invite steam friend feature enabled.
- UI upgrade and improvements both menu and in-game.
- Native 4K UI support.
- Widescreen support.
- Active server and ping indicator on menu.
- Network improvements for a better multiplayer experience (Selectable regions for better ping).
- Upgraded tutorial system .
- Bug Fixes.

notes.title: V1.1 Update - New Mode - Gameplay Improvements!
notes.content:
Hello dear BBQ Lovers! Firstly Hope everything well for everyone. After a short break BBQ Simulator The Squad has been updated to V1.1 Also we got some awesome news! BBQ Simulator has passed 100.000 sales on Steam!

We listened to the feedback of our valuable players and made some improvements and many improvements for the BBQ Simulator: The Squad.

So what's waiting for you in this update:

- A New Party Mode! Pirates. (Now the game contains 14 Modes!)
- Full XBOX Controller Support.
- Full Keybinding System.
- Complete UI Upgrade.
- Tutorials Upgraded.
- New Interaction System.
- New Notificiation System.
- Head bobbing completelety solved.
- Multiplayer gameplay performance improvements.
- Gameplay User Experience improvements.
- Much Bug Fixes.

notes.title: Release Announcement
notes.content:
After 7 month of “Early Access” stage we are finally ready to release the BBQ Simulator: The Squad!! We started with only 4 mods and simpler mechanics. Now with the release update, with 13 modes, new mechanics (fluids, fighting etc), new recipes, achievements and many new mini games. 

Now it is your turn to have a BBQ with your friends, by feeding the BBQKong and destroying the city or defeating zombie waves by giving them cooked brains!

notes.title: 1.0 Release Notes
notes.content:
-6 new Modes (Zombie Attack, BBQKong, Homeless Man, Golden Meat, Eat The Most and Line Race)
